Counsel for Applicant :- Anupesh Kumar,Sandeep Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
The present bail application has been filed by accused-applicant seeking bail in Case Crime No.0202 of 2022 under Section 498A, 306 Indian Penal Code, Police Station Kothi, District Barabanki.
It is alleged in the First Information Report that the daughter of the informant was married with the applicant few years ago.
Soon after the marriage she was subjected to beating and cruelty for demand of dowry.
In the dowry, motorcycle and a gold chain was demanded.
It is further alleged Brajesh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

1 that on 16.5.2022 at about 4.30 p.m. the accused Brajesh, father-in-law and mother-in-law of the deceased have killed her.
She has two children.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that cause of death could not be ascertained in the postmortem report.
The deceased died after 10 years of marriage.
Viscera was preserved.
In the viscera report Chlorpyrifos insecticide poison was found.
He submits that case is of circumstantial evidence.

Except general allegation there is no material against the applicant even the son of the deceased has made a statement that there was a broil between his parents in the morning and after that his father went to play cricket and thereafter the incident has taken place.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that to make out a case for implicating the applicant under Section 306 Indian Penal Code there should be a clear mens rea to commit the offence which is missing in this case.
In support of his contention he has relied upon the judgement of Hon'ble Supreme Court in Mariano Anto Bruno and another vs. Inspector of Police reported in 2022 SCC OnLine Sc 1387.

entities.text: Mariano Anto Bruno and another vs. Inspector of Police reported in 2022 SCC OnLine Sc 1387
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Emphasis is on paragraph 42.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer, however, could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

On due consideration to the submissions advanced, perusal of the record as also the facts that the applicant is languishing in jail since 6.12.2022, the applicant has no criminal history, statement of the son of the applicant as also the judgement of Hon'ble Supreme Court (supra) and without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Brajesh be released on bail in aforesaid case crime number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court concerned with the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.

(iii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iv) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(v) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
